bio: Sit back and experience Afternoon Tea with a modern twist. Enjoy a range of sweets and savouries made from the finest seasonal ingredients.  The English love affair with ‘a cup of tea’ is enacted daily in homes throughout the land. Afternoon Tea at Copthorne Tara Hotel is the definitive experience, full of tradition, celebration and a tremendous amount of cake.  The Afternoon Tea is served in the Bugis Street restaurant is our signature restaurant and it is located inside of the Copthorne Tara Hotel, on the ground floor.  Afternoon Tea is served daily at a cost of £32 per person, £38 per person with a glass of Prosecco or £50 per person with a bottle of prosecco.
